title: Gabriel's Message
altTitles: The Angel Gabriel From Heaven Came
author: Basque
credit: Traditional Basque Carol; Paraphrased by Sabine Baring Gould, (1834-1924).
firstLine: The angel Gabriel from heaven came,
verses: The angel Gabriel from heaven came,
his wings as drifted snow, his eyes as flame;
"All hail," said he, "thou lowly maiden, Mary,
"For know a blessed Mother thou shalt be,
all generations laud and honor thee,
thy Son shall be Emmanuel, by seers foretold,
Then gentle Mary meekly bowed her head,
"To me be as it pleaseth God," she said,
"my soul shall laud and magnify His holy Name."
Of her, Emmanuel, the Christ was born
in Bethlehem, all on a Christmas morn,
and Christian folk throughout the world will ever say
